en.body:
# Libre AI

AI work you can verify.

Libre AI brings together tools and documented product scopes for AI-assisted work. This portfolio map describes each repository’s responsibility. It does not certify that every product or capability is available.

Read a repository’s own capability statement, limits and evidence before using it. A proposed contract is not a canonical commitment until its authority admits it. Admission of a contract does not establish that an implementation is available.

## Products

- [Libre AI Work Supervision](https://github.com/libre-ai/ai-work-supervision) — Define and follow AI-assisted work.
- [Libre AI Model Policy](https://github.com/libre-ai/ai-model-policy) — Model usage policies.
- [Libre AI Practice Workbench](https://github.com/libre-ai/ai-practice-workbench) — Practice with guided activities.
- [Libre AI Learning Session Facilitation](https://github.com/libre-ai/learning-session-facilitation) — Prepare and facilitate source-based learning sessions.
- [Libre AI Personal Knowledge Notebook](https://github.com/libre-ai/personal-knowledge-notebook) — Capture and organize working notes.
- [Libre AI Information Feed Filter](https://github.com/libre-ai/information-feed-filter) — Follow sourced information.
- [Libre AI Travel Itinerary Planner](https://github.com/libre-ai/travel-itinerary-planner) — Plan travel from sourced information.
- [Libre AI Public Vote Comparison](https://github.com/libre-ai/public-vote-comparison) — Compare privately with sourced public votes.

## Components and tools

- [Libre AI Application Development Toolkit](https://github.com/libre-ai/application-development-toolkit) — Shared application components.
- [Libre AI Schemas And Contracts](https://github.com/libre-ai/schemas-and-contracts) — Canonical exchange contracts.
- [Libre AI Collaborative Data Sync](https://github.com/libre-ai/collaborative-data-sync) — Synchronization.
- [Libre AI Execution Continuity Evaluator](https://github.com/libre-ai/execution-continuity-evaluator) — Evaluate execution continuity without executing work.
- [Libre AI Execution Sandbox](https://github.com/libre-ai/execution-sandbox) — Execution confinement.
- [Libre AI Capability Authorization](https://github.com/libre-ai/capability-authorization) — Explicit permissions.
- [Libre AI Organization Data Lifecycle](https://github.com/libre-ai/organization-data-lifecycle) — Data lifecycle rules.
- [Libre AI Database Policy Inspector](https://github.com/libre-ai/database-policy-inspector) — Database inspection.
- [Libre AI Artifact Verification](https://github.com/libre-ai/artifact-verification) — Artifact verification.

## Project

- [Libre AI](https://github.com/libre-ai/.github) — Portfolio navigation.
- [Libre AI Project Website](https://github.com/libre-ai/project-website) — Public overview.
- [Libre AI Project Governance](https://github.com/libre-ai/project-governance) — Shared rules and decisions.

## Contribute

Start with the relevant repository and its contribution instructions. Keep security reports private; never put secrets or personal data in a public issue.

[Contribution guide](https://github.com/libre-ai/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Security reporting](https://github.com/libre-ai/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md) · [Français](https://github.com/libre-ai/.github/blob/main/profile/README.fr.md)

fr.body:
# Libre AI

Du travail d’IA que vous pouvez vérifier.

Libre AI rassemble des outils et des périmètres produits documentés pour travailler avec l’IA. Cette carte décrit le rôle de chaque dépôt. Elle ne certifie pas que chaque produit ou capacité est disponible.

Avant usage, consultez les capacités déclarées, les limites et les preuves du dépôt concerné. Un contrat proposé ne constitue pas un engagement canonique avant son admission par son autorité. L’admission d’un contrat ne prouve pas qu’une implémentation est disponible.

## Produits

- [Libre AI Work Supervision](https://github.com/libre-ai/ai-work-supervision) — Définir et suivre le travail assisté par IA.
- [Libre AI Model Policy](https://github.com/libre-ai/ai-model-policy) — Politiques d’usage des modèles.
- [Libre AI Practice Workbench](https://github.com/libre-ai/ai-practice-workbench) — Pratiquer avec des activités guidées.
- [Libre AI Learning Session Facilitation](https://github.com/libre-ai/learning-session-facilitation) — Préparer et faciliter des sessions d’apprentissage sourcées.
- [Libre AI Personal Knowledge Notebook](https://github.com/libre-ai/personal-knowledge-notebook) — Saisir et organiser les notes de travail.
- [Libre AI Information Feed Filter](https://github.com/libre-ai/information-feed-filter) — Suivre des informations sourcées.
- [Libre AI Travel Itinerary Planner](https://github.com/libre-ai/travel-itinerary-planner) — Préparer des voyages à partir d’informations sourcées.
- [Libre AI Public Vote Comparison](https://github.com/libre-ai/public-vote-comparison) — Comparer en privé avec des votes publics sourcés.

## Composants et outils

- [Libre AI Application Development Toolkit](https://github.com/libre-ai/application-development-toolkit) — Composants applicatifs partagés.
- [Libre AI Schemas And Contracts](https://github.com/libre-ai/schemas-and-contracts) — Contrats canoniques d’échange.
- [Libre AI Collaborative Data Sync](https://github.com/libre-ai/collaborative-data-sync) — Synchronisation.
- [Libre AI Execution Continuity Evaluator](https://github.com/libre-ai/execution-continuity-evaluator) — Évaluer la continuité des exécutions sans exécuter le travail.
- [Libre AI Execution Sandbox](https://github.com/libre-ai/execution-sandbox) — Confinement des exécutions.
- [Libre AI Capability Authorization](https://github.com/libre-ai/capability-authorization) — Permissions explicites.
- [Libre AI Organization Data Lifecycle](https://github.com/libre-ai/organization-data-lifecycle) — Règles du cycle de vie des données.
- [Libre AI Database Policy Inspector](https://github.com/libre-ai/database-policy-inspector) — Inspection des bases de données.
- [Libre AI Artifact Verification](https://github.com/libre-ai/artifact-verification) — Vérification des artefacts.

## Projet

- [Libre AI](https://github.com/libre-ai/.github) — Navigation du portefeuille.
- [Libre AI Project Website](https://github.com/libre-ai/project-website) — Présentation publique.
- [Libre AI Project Governance](https://github.com/libre-ai/project-governance) — Règles et décisions communes.

## Contribuer

Commencez par le dépôt concerné et ses instructions de contribution. Gardez les signalements de sécurité privés ; ne mettez jamais de secrets ou de données personnelles dans une issue publique.

[Guide de contribution](https://github.com/libre-ai/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Signalement de sécurité](https://github.com/libre-ai/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md) · [English](https://github.com/libre-ai/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md)
